name: Four Seasons Resort Koh Samui
insider_take: This hillside sanctuary perfectly balances Thai authenticity with Four Seasons luxury, where infinity pools seem to spill directly into the Gulf of Thailand.
whats_special: The resort's villas are built into the natural rock formations of Koh Samui's coastline, with some featuring private infinity pools that appear to merge seamlessly with the ocean horizon. The property sits on a secluded stretch of Laem Yai Bay, accessible only by the resort's private pier or dramatic hillside entrance.
pro_tip: Book the Secret Earth Villa for ultimate privacy - it's the resort's most secluded accommodation, nestled so deep in the tropical landscape that it feels like your own private island retreat.
dont_miss: The resort's unique "dining by design" experiences, including a private dinner on your villa's infinity pool deck or a romantic setup on the resort's hidden beach cove. The spa's signature treatments using locally-sourced coconut and lemongrass are performed in tree-house style pavilions suspended in the jungle canopy.
pros: Stunning beachfront location with pristine white sand beach
Luxurious villas with private pools and exceptional Four Seasons service
World-class spa featuring traditional Thai treatments
Multiple dining venues with panoramic ocean views
